      --socket-count       Socket count per process. (Default: 1)

      --verify-ip          Verify IP addresses of incoming replies.
  -w  --outfile            Write to the specified output file instead of standard output.

Output flags:
  L - domain list output
  S - simple text output
  F - full text output
  B - binary output
  J - ndjson output

Advanced flags for the domain list output mode:
  0 - Include NOERROR replies without answers.

Advanced flags for the simple output mode:
  d - Include records from the additional section.
  i - Indent any reply record.
  l - Separate replies using a line feed.
  m - Only output reply records that match the question name.

--busy-poll.help: Use busy-wait polling instead of epoll.

--domains.help: File containing domains for certificate search.

--drop-group.help: Group to drop privileges to when running as root. (Default: nogroup)

--drop-user.help: User to drop privileges to when running as root. (Default: nobody)

--extended-input.help: Input names are followed by a space-separated list of resolvers. These are used before falling back to the resolvers file.

--filter.help: Only output packets with the specified response code.

--flush.help: Flush the output file whenever a response was received.

--help.help: Shows a help text that is more compressed than this man page.

--ignore.help: Do not output packets with the specified response code.

--no-wildcard-filter.help: Do not filter replies that appear to be wildcard responses.

--norecurse.help: Use non-recursive queries. Useful for DNS cache snooping.

--outfile.help: Store results in file instead of printing to stdout

--predictable.help: Use resolvers incrementally. Useful for resolver tests.

--processes.help: Number of processes to be used for resolving. (Default: 1)

--quiet.help: When this option is specified, massdns will not print progress stats and it will not display some warnings.

--rand-src-ipv6.help: Use a random IPv6 address from the specified subnet for each query.

--rcvbuf.help: Size of the receive buffer in bytes.

--retry.help: Unacceptable DNS response codes. (Default: All codes but NOERROR or NXDOMAIN)

--root.help: Do not drop privileges when running as root. Not recommended.

--skip-avail-check.help: Do not test whether nameservers are available.

--sndbuf.help: Size of the send buffer in bytes.

--status-fmt.help: This option can be either "json" or "ansi". When it is not specified, it defaults to "ansi", causing massdns to print out stats in human-readable format to stderr. In case you want to automate the use of massdns, you may want to use "json" to parse the output.

--status-format.help: Format for real-time status updates, json or ansi (Default: ansi)

--sticky.help: Do not switch the resolver when retrying.

--type.help: DNS record type to test against.

--verify-ip.help: Verify IP addresses of incoming replies.

-b.help: --bindto             Bind to IP address and port. (Default: 0.0.0.0:0)

-c.help: --resolve-count      Number of resolves for a name before giving up. (Default: 50)

-i.help: --interval           Interval in milliseconds to wait between multiple resolves of the same domain. (Default: 500)

-t.help: --type               Record type to be resolved. (Default: A)

-w.help: --outfile            Write to the specified output file instead of standard output.
